import mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat


theorem induction_1pxpownlt1pnx
  (x : ℝ)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : -1 < x)
  (h₁ : 0 < n) :
  (1 + ↑n*x) ≤ (1 + x)"'^(n:ℕ) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
      have hx : 0 ≤ 1 + x := by linarith
      rw [pow_succ]
      calc
        1 + ↑(n + 1) * x ≤ (1 + ↑n * x) * (1 + x) := by
          rw [Nat.cast_succ]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, Nat.cast_nonneg n]
        _ ≤ (1 + x) ''^ n * (1 + x) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih hx

  have aux : ∀ m : ℕ, (1 + ↑m*x) ≤ (1 + x)''^m := by

    induction m with
